description: Preprocessing: scaler fitted on data that includes the test period
Split: random/shuffled train-test split of a time series
Look-ahead feature: feature uses future values (negative shift, centred/forward window)
Target leakage: feature derived from the target at the same step
Imputation: gap filling uses future observations
Cross-validation: shuffled/non-temporal CV used to report performance
Model selection: hyper-parameters chosen on the test set
Decomposition/climatology computed on the full series incl. test period
